This '''species''' was an [[alien]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TROS" /> [[Sweebotta]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Sweebotta" />

==Biology and appearance==
This quadrupedal [[species]] was distinguished by their long limbs and [[Color|tan]] [[Hair|fur]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Species in the galaxy==
A member of this species named [[Sweebotta]] roamed the streets of [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]<ref name="Kenobi II">{{Kenobi|Part II}}</ref> by [[9 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Kenobi|Part II}} to [[9 BBY]].</ref> Later, in [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROSDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' to [[35 ABY]].</ref> another member of this species was present on the planet [[Kijimi]] shortly before its destruction.<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species first debuted in the [[2019]] film {{Film|IX}},directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TROS" />
